name: Dungeon Crush
summary:
Dungeon Crush is a pixel-art dungeon roguelite in which combat is played by drawing links between matching tiles on a board. Swords deal damage, shields block, potions heal, gold buys items and mana charges spells; longer links and repeated tile types build up multipliers, and enemies telegraph their next attack in exact numbers, making each turn a solvable puzzle.

The board refills from the player's own bag of tiles, which grows and changes over a run as tiles are added, upgraded, removed and etched with runes. Runs cross three acts of generated maps, and between acts the player returns to the town of Emberfall, rescuing its residents and rebuilding it over time.
